name: Lummi
summary: Free AI stock library of 50,000+ photos, illustrations and 3D assets, royalty-free for commercial use, with a Pro tier.
description: A stock library of AI-generated and human-curated photos, illustrations and 3D assets, browsable by category, colour, orientation, luminance and number of people. The free tier covers the whole catalogue with attribution; Lummi Pro ($10/mo billed yearly) adds watermark-free downloads, ultra-resolution upscaling, reframe, retouch, background removal and AI credits. Images can also come in through a REST API and plugins for Figma, Webflow, Canva, Adobe Express and Framer.
contains: 50,000+ curated AI photos, illustrations and 3D assets
royalty-free for personal and commercial use; no reselling or bundling
free tier with attribution; Pro $10/mo billed yearly ($15 monthly)

curated collections, creator profiles and trending shoots
